subject: Seek clarification of a missing link
rationale: Examining evidence for a particular unresolved link faithfully extends the source operation of inspecting handling histories for continuity and unexplained transitions. It can improve order-specific attribution relevant to distinguishing explanations for nonpurchase. The proposal confines customer clarification to agreed follow-up and preserves unresolved gaps. This licenses seeking clarification; it does not establish that missing evidence exists, that a link will be resolved, or that clarification will identify the cause of the decline.
